page.overview:
Who is Angela?

Angela is a character from Family Guy. She appeared in the episode The Simpsons Guy. She is Peter's boss at the Pawtucket Brewery.

In the episode The Simpsons Guy, Family Guy characters were sitting next to The Simpsons characters for being rip offs of them. One of which was Angela. She was not a rip off of a certain character, but she had to be there because this was a case, where The Pawtucket Brewery was possibly going to be shut down, and being the boss of the brewery, she was of course, going to be there.
